# Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit below this line.

When the browser meets a `<script>` with a `src`, it stops reading the HTML until the file is downloaded and run. Nothing below the tag is shown in the meantime. A slow third-party server then holds up your whole page.

With `async` or `defer`, the browser keeps reading the HTML while the file downloads. `Script` from `next/script` does not block either, and lets you pick when the script loads.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```jsx
export default function Checkout() {
  return <script src="https://example.com/payments.js" />;
}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
export default function Checkout() {
  return <script src="https://example.com/payments.js" defer />;
}
```

{/* good */}
```jsx
import Script from "next/script";

export default function Checkout() {
  return <Script src="https://example.com/payments.js" />;
}
```
